title: Implement decode() and encode() / encode_part() public API
description:
Implement the public API in src/decode.rs and src/encode.rs, wiring together the header parser and byte transform.

PUBLIC TYPES:
  pub struct YencMetadata { pub filename: String, pub size: u64, pub line_length: u8 }
  pub struct DecodedPart {
      pub data: Vec<u8>,
      pub metadata: YencMetadata,
      pub part: Option<u32>,      // from =ybegin part=
      pub total: Option<u32>,     // from =ybegin total=
      pub begin: Option<u64>,     // from =ypart begin= (1-based)
      pub end: Option<u64>,       // from =ypart end= (1-based)
      pub crc32_verified: bool,   // true if crc was present and matched
      pub is_truncated: bool,     // true if =yend was not found
  }

decode(input: &[u8]) -> Result<DecodedPart, YencError>:
1. Scan forward line by line until a line starting with b'=ybegin ' is found. If none: Err(NoHeader).
2. Parse =ybegin line.
3. If next line starts with b'=ypart ': parse it; advance.
4. Pass remaining lines through decode_bytes() until a line starting with b'=yend ' is found.
5. Parse =yend line.
6. Verify CRC32: if pcrc32= present, verify decoded data; if only crc32= present (single-part), verify; if mismatch: Err(CrcMismatch).
7. If =yend never found: set is_truncated=true, return Ok with partial data.
8. No panics on any input.

encode(data: &[u8], filename: &str) -> Vec<u8>:
- Produces =ybegin line=128 size={len} name={filename}\r\n
- Encoded data lines
- =yend size={len} crc32={crc:08x}\r\n
- Uses DEFAULT_LINE_LENGTH=128

encode_part(data: &[u8], filename: &str, total_size: u64, part: u32, begin: u64, end: u64) -> Vec<u8>:
- Produces =ybegin part={part} line=128 size={total_size} name={filename}\r\n
- =ypart begin={begin} end={end}\r\n
- Encoded data lines
- =yend size={data.len()} part={part} pcrc32={pcrc32:08x}\r\n
- begin/end are 1-based byte offsets into the complete reassembled file

Tests (oracle: reference yEnc encoder output or Python arithmetic, NOT this crate's encode):
- decode well-formed single-part article: correct data, metadata, crc32_verified=true
- decode well-formed multi-part article: correct begin/end offsets, pcrc32 verified
- decode with preceding prose before =ybegin: finds the block correctly
- decode with CRC mismatch: Err(CrcMismatch)
- decode with no =yend: is_truncated=true, partial data returned as Ok
- decode empty input: Err(NoHeader)
- encode then decode: round-trip identity (this round-trip test is OK for the combined function test; the transform tests use external oracle)
- encode_part: =ypart line has correct begin=/end= values
close_reason: Public API in lib.rs: decode(), encode(), encode_part() with EncodePartOptions struct, YencMetadata, DecodedPart, YencError all exported. 5 doc-tests pass.
